name: Movie Recommendation & Discovery
description: Personalized movie discovery with explainable hybrid recommendations, ratings, preferences, and offline evaluation.
summary: Content and collaborative signals are combined with explicit user preferences. Discovery tools, explanation cards, and offline benchmarks make recommendation behavior inspectable, including cold-start conditions.
architecture: Next.js presents discovery and recommendation pages backed by FastAPI. PostgreSQL stores catalog, user ratings, and preferences. Persisted TF-IDF and bias-centered TruncatedSVD artifacts feed adaptive hybrid ranking; offline evaluation measures ranking quality and coverage.

stack.usage: Pages provide searchable catalog views, preferences, recommendation cards, and analytics.
Shared client types describe movie records and recommendation explanations.
Services expose ratings, discovery, personalized ranking, and analytics.
Python assembles content and collaborative candidates with adaptive scoring.
TF-IDF vectorizes movie metadata; bias-centered TruncatedSVD models sparse ratings.
Numerical operations support score combination and evaluation diagnostics.
ORM repositories access movies, ratings, and preference profiles.
The database persists MovieLens catalog records and application-user interactions.
Backend tests check ranking, API behavior, and artifact validation.
